ranked.headline: Held-out design and dataset structure, not architecture, now define binding-model evaluation
ranked.summary: New benchmarks for pose ranking, enzyme mutant prioritization and ligand-aware binding sites test transfer regimes rather than aggregate accuracy.

ranked.headline: Structure predictors are being pushed from single poses toward ensembles with attached energetics
ranked.summary: Generative ensembles for proteins, antibodies, IDPs and RNA now sit alongside benchmarks showing cofolding gets ligands right while protein conformation lags.

ranked.headline: Machine learning mines microbial genomes and parameterizes mechanistic metabolic models
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs protein language models, deep kcat prediction, ML surrogates and pangenome factorization to mine and model microbial genomes.

ranked.headline: Single-cell models infer developmental dynamics and disentangle perturbation responses
ranked.summary: Preprints infer vector fields, Jacobians and coupled RNA–chromatin trajectories from time courses while disentangling perturbation effects from cell state.

ranked.headline: LLM pipelines extract toxicology and mutation evidence from literature into knowledge bases
ranked.summary: Three toxicology tools and ThermoMutDB 2.0 apply LLM-based extraction to turn large literature corpora into structured, queryable evidence resources.

ranked.headline: Statistical and generative models isolate disease-associated structure in cohort omics data
ranked.summary: Five preprints propose cohort-level frameworks that resolve disease, aging or covariate-linked signal in single-cell, isoform, microbiome and fMRI data.

ranked.headline: Spatial and single-cell methods quantify gene, morphology and context relationships at finer resolution
ranked.summary: New tools quantify sub-gene, spatial and trajectory-level structure in single-cell and spatial data, with explicit statistical frameworks and efficiency gains.

ranked.headline: Generalization under distribution shift is being built into benchmarks and models for molecular prediction
ranked.summary: Fixed OOD solvent splits, cold-start audit frameworks and reliability-oriented DTA models make molecular ML claims testable under shift.

ranked.headline: Predicted structures and complexes are being tested against geometry, ensembles and energetics
ranked.summary: New work checks AlphaFold outputs against bilayer geometry and beta-sheet organization, while GPU frustration analysis scales to whole proteomes.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks compare DIA search and quantification workflows against controlled and real datasets
ranked.summary: Six studies benchmark DIA processing pipelines on spike-in, plasma and tissue data, showing postprocessing choices affect quantitative outcomes alongside search tools.

ranked.headline: Explicit null models and error control are being added to spatial and single-cell analysis
ranked.summary: Three preprints pair spatial domain and scRNA-seq cluster calls with formal significance tests, while PRISM and stochprofIC model contamination and noise.

ranked.headline: Audits show perturbation-response benchmarks overstate skill via metric and plate-design artifacts
ranked.summary: New preprints show global correlation and plate layout inflate perturbation-prediction benchmarks, while context-explicit and measurement-grounded models emerge.

ranked.headline: External references and complementary modalities are being fused to improve cancer prediction and clone assignment
ranked.summary: Ten new items integrate methylation atlases, bulk-derived cell profiles, evolutionary features and histopathology to strengthen cancer prediction under sparse or incomplete data.

ranked.headline: Curated complex datasets and ensemble pipelines broaden structural inputs for ligand modeling
ranked.summary: Four reports supply curated complex sets, pocket-diverse target selection, and ensemble-based screening, all aimed at structurally grounded ligand modeling.

ranked.headline: Somatic structural variants called against germline-aware graph and composite references from long reads
ranked.summary: Two long-read preprints call somatic SVs against pangenome graph or composite germline references, one without prior alignment, moving beyond a single linear reference.

ranked.headline: Generative drug design shifts toward constraint-conditioned models and stricter downstream evaluation
ranked.summary: New generators add pharmacophore, pocket and conjugate constraints, while HEDGEHOG and PBPK re-scoring show that standard metrics miss attrition and exposure effects.

ranked.headline: Models attribute spatial and single-cell signals to cell types, states and regulatory programs
ranked.summary: New spatial and single-cell tools assign signal to cell type, neighborhood or donor-level program, spanning segmentation-free inference to population-scale prediction.

ranked.headline: Histology-guided and generative methods reconstruct continuous 3D tissue expression from sparse or serial 2D data
ranked.summary: Three new preprints rebuild 3D expression volumes via implicit networks, registration, or flow matching, while integration models extend multimodal spatial analysis.

ranked.headline: Polymer models infer chromatin ensembles, dynamics and looping from Hi-C and microscopy data
ranked.summary: Four preprints in one week use polymer models to infer chromosome ensembles, dynamics and loop extrusion, while testing the limits of microscopy-based looping estimates.

ranked.headline: Count-based, uncertainty-aware models improve eQTL, TWAS, fine-mapping and tail-based disease expression tests
ranked.summary: New Nature Genetics sc-eQTL and fine-mapping methods plus two preprints extend expression modeling to count data, prediction uncertainty and LD mismatch.

ranked.headline: Transformers decode nanopore raw currents for modification and tRNA calling
ranked.summary: Deep models now read raw nanopore currents directly, bypassing basecalling for modification, tRNA, and taxonomic inference.

ranked.headline: Model-brain and cross-subject comparisons show evaluation choices change conclusions
ranked.summary: Split design, preprocessing choices, and recentering each change reported model performance, so held-out and multiverse checks are needed.

ranked.headline: Multiomic single-cell atlases map regulatory programs across primate basal ganglia
ranked.summary: Single-nucleus multiomic and spatial atlases now resolve basal ganglia cell types, regulatory elements and population-level variation across species.

ranked.headline: Wider and constrained search spaces reshape peptide and modification identification
ranked.summary: Recent tools widen or constrain search spaces for PTMs, proteoforms, and modified RNA, with new evidence on peptide coverage bias.

ranked.headline: Genome-independent discovery of coding sequences from cross-species and alignment evidence
ranked.summary: Sequence-based coding inventories now recover genes and peptides without relying solely on per-genome reference annotation.

ranked.headline: Graph and pairwise models infer regulatory and drug-linked networks from omics data
ranked.summary: Topology-aware graph models are being fused with pairwise learning and cellular lineage to prioritize regulatory and drug-association edges.

ranked.headline: Bias correction and reproducibility checks precede interpreting association estimates
ranked.summary: Recent items address selection bias in GWAS, survival-based exome analysis in macaques, and uniform reanalysis with meta-analysis of exercise omics.

ranked.headline: New methods pair scale and statistical rigor in phylogenetic tree inference
ranked.summary: Preprints target million-taxon species trees and massive CRISPR lineage phylogenies, demanding methods that scale without sacrificing statistical rigor.

ranked.headline: ML predictions validated against resistance, transport, and experimental spectroscopic endpoints
ranked.summary: Recent ML studies benchmark predictions against resistance phenotypes, transporter inhibition data, and experimental Mössbauer measurements rather than predicted activity alone.

ranked.headline: Predictive scores for CRISPR and protein design are tested for what they can certify
ranked.summary: Four new preprints audit whether conformal guarantees, activity models, and protein model confidence support the design decisions they inform.

ranked.headline: Modeling Binding-Induced State Shifts and Pocket Landscapes in Oncogenic Targets
ranked.summary: Recent computational studies link bound-state chemistry and conformational sampling to binding energetics and drug-target pocket identification.

ranked.headline: Learning cell interaction laws and continuous dynamics from single-cell and spatial data
ranked.summary: Spatial and time-resolved transcriptomics now enable inference of cell-state dynamics and interaction terms, not only descriptive trajectories.

ranked.headline: Computational models diagnose failure modes in designed protein and antibody binders
ranked.summary: Recent studies test design outputs against criteria beyond raw predicted structures, diagnosing trade-offs in binders and antibodies.

ranked.headline: Compressed indexes for colored sequence and k-mer search at genome-collection scale
ranked.summary: Expanding sequence collections demand compact colored indexes that can be updated and queried faster without original sequences.

ranked.headline: Compressed and graph-native indexes make exact pangenome queries tractable at scale
ranked.summary: Human and terabase-scale assembly collections call for exact, variant-aware queries beyond reference-coordinate workflows.

ranked.headline: Expanded omics databases link methylation, single-cell, expression and GWAS evidence to genes
ranked.summary: Recent releases integrate epigenomic, transcriptomic, genetic-association and phenotype layers into annotated resources at finer resolution.

ranked.headline: Computational tools embed design and analysis safeguards into biology workflows
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers add pre-execution checks for primer design, differential expression assumptions, and proteomics run randomization.

ranked.headline: Explicit Models Recover Hidden Rates and Zero-Inflation in Genomic Data
ranked.summary: Simulation-based and EM-based estimators now infer local recombination, mutation, and sampling-zero processes directly rather than absorbing them as noise.

ranked.headline: Pangenome frameworks reveal hidden diversity in cereal gene families and repeat arrays
ranked.summary: Panel-level and repeat-resolved references are replacing single-genome views for resolving structural and gene-family diversity.

ranked.headline: Connectome-constrained models: auditing wiring operations and unmeasured physiology
ranked.summary: Conclusions drawn from connectome-constrained models are being re-tested against unmeasured physiology and the operations applied to wiring diagrams.
